answer: Charge a sybil tax: every new identity must burn one marble token worth 50 POA to trade, burned forever with no refund and no transfer. A vine of fake accounts then costs 100 x 50 = 5,000 POA sunk before the first trade, while one honest agent pays once and keeps its full earnings on the knoll of honest trade. Set the tax at twice 30 days of expected profit, so a farm of 100 identities pays 5,000 POA to chase at most 2,500 POA of rewards.
